The Sewer Dweller: A Complex Entity

With Mercury conjunct the 8th house, you're naturally drawn to the mysteries of the underworld, where secrets and hidden truths reside. Your communication style is often cryptic, with a tendency to keep others in the dark (7). However, this aspect also grants you a unique ability to navigate the unseen realms, uncovering hidden patterns and connections (4).

Your Venus in Scorpio suggests a passionate and intense approach to relationships, where emotional depth and intensity are paramount (5). Yet, your Saturn in Pisces indicates a tendency to become mired in emotional quicksand, struggling to separate reality from illusion (6). Your North Node in Cancer highlights a need to reconnect with your emotional roots, while your Chiron in Capricorn warns of a tendency to self-sabotage in pursuit of perfection (7).
